title: Get Microsoft’s latest coding tools and a full training bootcamp on sale for $44.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: A lifetime license to Visual Studio Pro 2026 plus 16 coding courses is on sale for $44.97 (reg. $1,999.99) through October 4.

Learning to code usually means paying for a professional IDE and then hunting down separate tutorials to actually use it. Buy each piece on its own, and you’ll spend hundreds. If you want to get it all at once, this bundle gives you Visual Studio Pro 2026 and a full coding bundle together for $44.97.

Visual Studio 2026 runs on Windows, so Mac users can install it through Parallels Desktop or Boot Camp and get the same 64-bit IDE that professional teams use. It also now comes with AI code completion through IntelliCode and real-time Live Share collaboration that lets teammates join a session without cloning the repo first.

The training bundle covers everything from writing your first line of Python to building apps that can recognize a face in a photo. You’ll start with the basics of a language and end up scraping data off websites, automating a browser with Selenium, and building working web apps in Flask. You’ll also learn C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL databases with MySQL, and how to build iOS and Android apps from a single Flutter and Dart codebase. One course builds 15 computer vision projects in OpenCV, from swapping faces to detecting lanes for a self-driving car, and a few newer ones get into OpenAI fundamentals and writing Salesforce code with ChatGPT.

Own your dev tools and the training to use them.

Get the Visual Studio Professional 2026 coding bundle on sale for $44.97.

Sale ends October 4 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
